panel.label: Region Cache
panel.name: ss_roc
panel.text: Remembers the lasting scenery of a region and paints it back when you return.

button.name: ss_roc_help
button.tool_tip: Instead of waiting for a familiar place to stream in again. Click for what is remembered, and what is deliberately left alone.

check_box.label: Enable the region object cache
check_box.name: ss_roc_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Off by default while this is still being proven. Takes effect on the next region you enter.

button.name: ss_roc_promotion_help
button.tool_tip: Why time is the evidence, and why auto-return changes it

slider.label: Hours that count as a return visit:
slider.name: SSROCVisitHours
slider.tool_tip: Time you actually spend somewhere is evidence that it is worth remembering. Every this many hours in a region counts as visiting it again, so an evening at home is worth more than passing through.

slider.label: Visits before caching:
slider.name: SSROCPromoteVisits
slider.tool_tip: How many visits an object must be present for before it is cached, when it is already known to be safe from parcel auto-return.

slider.label: Days before caching the rest:
slider.name: SSROCPromoteDaysUnproven
slider.tool_tip: Separate days an object must be seen when it could not be shown to be safe from auto-return. Only real days count here, not hours in one sitting, because an object on a return timer can vanish between one hour and the next.

slider.label: How permanent it must look:
slider.name: SSROCPromoteScore
slider.tool_tip: Lower values cache more of a region, including things that change more often. Higher values cache only the most obviously permanent scenery.

check_box.label: Only cache objects that cannot be auto-returned
check_box.name: ss_roc_require_proof
check_box.tool_tip: Strictest option. When off, objects that could be auto-returned are still cached once they have been seen on enough separate days.

button.name: ss_roc_limits_help
button.tool_tip: What each limit bounds, and what gets dropped first

slider.label: Objects remembered per region:
slider.name: SSROCMaxRecordsPerRegion
slider.tool_tip: Thirty thousand covers a full region at its maximum object count. Lower it to spend less memory and disk on very dense regions.

slider.label: Objects drawn from memory on arrival:
slider.name: SSROCMaxGhostsPerRegion
slider.tool_tip: How much of a remembered region may be painted back at once when you arrive. Lower it if arriving somewhere dense feels heavy.

slider.label: Disk space for the cache (MB):
slider.name: SSROCDiskBudgetMB
slider.tool_tip: A ceiling for the whole cache, not per region. Regions you have not visited for the longest are dropped first, and only when the limit is approached.

slider.label: Seconds to keep unconfirmed scenery:
slider.name: SSROCGhostTTL
slider.tool_tip: Scenery drawn from memory that the simulator has not mentioned yet stops being drawn after this long. What was learned about it is kept either way.
